related.title: 水輪發電機定子製造
related.transfer: 可遷移「水頭、流量與出力」與「軸擺度與導軸承間隙」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；水輪發電機定子製造的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Head, discharge and output" and "Shaft runout and guide-bearing clearance" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Hydrogenerator Stator Manufacturing must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以數十微米油膜承載數千噸的可傾瓦推力軸承與導軸承；水輪發電機定子製造則以大直徑定子的鐵心疊裝、線棒絕緣與圓度控制為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on tilting-pad thrust and guide bearings carrying thousands of tonnes on films tens of micrometres thick; Hydrogenerator Stator Manufacturing centres on core stacking, bar insulation and roundness control of large-diameter stators, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「推力軸承的負載與比壓」與「水頭、流量與出力」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「啟停時的高壓油頂起」的模型移到水輪發電機定子製造，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「鐵損試驗與交流耐壓」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Thrust-bearing load and specific pressure" and "Head, discharge and output".
Move the model of "High-pressure oil jacking at start and stop" to Hydrogenerator Stator Manufacturing, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Core-loss test and AC withstand", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「水頭、流量與出力」與「軸擺度與導軸承間隙」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；水輪發電機定子製造的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Head, discharge and output" and "Shaft runout and guide-bearing clearance" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Hydrogenerator Stator Manufacturing must be respecified.

related.title: 法蘭西斯水輪機水力設計
related.transfer: 可遷移「水頭、流量與出力」與「軸擺度與導軸承間隙」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；法蘭西斯水輪機水力設計的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Head, discharge and output" and "Shaft runout and guide-bearing clearance" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Francis Turbine Hydraulic Design must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以數十微米油膜承載數千噸的可傾瓦推力軸承與導軸承；法蘭西斯水輪機水力設計則以以歐拉方程、模型試驗與流場計算設計高效率且穩定的法蘭西斯轉輪為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on tilting-pad thrust and guide bearings carrying thousands of tonnes on films tens of micrometres thick; Francis Turbine Hydraulic Design centres on designing efficient, stable Francis runners with the Euler equation, model tests and flow simulation, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「推力軸承的負載與比壓」與「水頭、流量與出力」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「啟停時的高壓油頂起」的模型移到法蘭西斯水輪機水力設計，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「尾水管渦帶與運轉禁區」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Thrust-bearing load and specific pressure" and "Head, discharge and output".
Move the model of "High-pressure oil jacking at start and stop" to Francis Turbine Hydraulic Design, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Draft-tube vortex rope and restricted zones", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「水頭、流量與出力」與「軸擺度與導軸承間隙」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；法蘭西斯水輪機水力設計的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Head, discharge and output" and "Shaft runout and guide-bearing clearance" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Francis Turbine Hydraulic Design must be respecified.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 水輪發電機推力軸承與導軸承
history.text: 1905 年米歇爾在澳洲取得可傾瓦軸承專利；1912 年金斯伯里軸承在霍爾特伍德電站運轉；1970s：蘇聯開始在大型機組採用彈性金屬塑料瓦；1987 年霍爾特伍德的金斯伯里軸承被列為機械工程里程碑。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計或運轉文件。
history.textEn: 1905: Michell patented the tilting-pad bearing in Australia. 1912: The Kingsbury bearing ran at Holtwood. 1970s: PTFE-faced pads were introduced on large units in the Soviet Union. 1987: The Holtwood Kingsbury bearing was designated a mechanical engineering landmark. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design or operating documents.
